name: map-controls
useFor: Put `MapControls` in the bottom-right corner, its bottom on the scale bar's line. Pass `onZoomIn` and `onZoomOut`; disable one at the zoom limit. `MapControlButton` is one key for other map actions, with a 16px glyph and an `aria-label`.
constraints: The 20px plus here; map glyphs are 16px
title: Map controls
description: Zoom in and zoom out: two square keys with the small cut, stacked in the map's bottom-right corner.
